== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The remastered Independent glyph retains the ship affiliation while dropping the unique-only limitation. It changes the unreducible Force loss from the top of Reserve Deck to directing that card to Lost Pile. The bonuses, bounty hunter trigger, target forfeit and Alter immunity remain.
